title: voc-agent-card/1: one agent role's card (agents/<role>/agent.yaml)
description: What the platform holds for a role beyond its instructions: its harness, model, tools, broker operations, caps and contracts. The role's instructions and examples are its SKILL.md. The compiler turns tools, model.id and harness into the voc-skill/1 record's tool_policy, model and harness. Budgets and caps never go in a skill record (engineering/skills/model.py NEVER_IN_A_SKILL), so they live here.

id.description: The role: the directory's name, SKILL.md's name and a member of AGENT_ROLES.

version.description: The template version: bump it on any change in this directory.

harness.description: converse or cli: a launchable role. learn: the built-in Learn step's card (coach/).

model.description: id: the model the skill was written and measured for, and the role's default: on the native harness as it is, on Kiro by Kiro's name for it (kiro_pin.kiro_model). A deployment chooses another per role (the Registry's Model) or per run (runtime/harness/model_choice.py), never on the card.

tools.description: The tool policy, in order: a subset of the harness's role_specs(role).

pending_tools.description: Tools SKILL.md names that the harness does not offer this role yet (they arrive with the runtime work). The validator fails once the harness offers one: it then moves into tools.

skills.description: 7.56.00: the library skills the role uses (skills/<name>/, by name). The harness lists each in the role's system prompt, its name and description, and read_skill answers its SKILL.md or one reference file: a launchable role with skills has read_skill among its tools (or pending_tools). Learn's card names the coach's skills, which its prompt carries whole (it has no tools).

broker_ops.description: The broker operations the role makes: read, and the writes the broker grants it (none for the Learn card).

pending_broker_ops.description: Broker operations the role needs that the broker does not grant it yet.

untrusted.description: What the role reads that is DATA, never an instruction.

fence.description: nonce: every tool result is fenced with a per-session random fence.

evals.description: The eval cases (<flow>/<case>) that measure this role.

from.description: <role>.<tool or output>, broker.read:<kind>, task, knowledge, memory, checkout, flow, board or transcripts.
